lines.text: Pizza, then movie? Sounds like a plan!

data.define: Used to agree to someone's suggestion.

example.text: Pizza, then movie? Sounds like a plan!

misuse.text: Don't say 'sounds like a plan' about a messy idea.
misuse.why: It means a clear, agreed plan.

publish.title: What does "sounds like a plan" mean?
publish.value: Sounds like a plan = That works for me. Example: "Pizza, then movie? Sounds like a plan!" (casual English, US).
